title: Guided camera restored
details: Photo and video now stay inside Evia instead of handing control to the phone camera app
The camera view fills the screen as much as possible while the evidence prompt remains visible
Video recording keeps the prompt on screen with a timer and Next prompt button
Each Next prompt press records its exact timestamp without stopping the continuous video
Photo capture still moves to the required written explanation and video still offers optional extra text or Skip text afterwards
summary: Evia v137 restores the full-screen guided photo and video capture flow.
changes: Kept photo prompts visible while taking evidence
Kept video prompts, timer and Next prompt visible while recording
Preserved prompt timestamps for the evidence record
Moved the offline shell to v137
